system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Reports a crop loss event for a specific policy and land parcel. Here are my details: my land_parcel_id is dummy_land_parcel_id_8682, my loss_type is dummy_loss_type_4577, my loss_date is dummy_loss_date_9697, my policy_id is None.

function.name: pmfby_report_crop_loss
function.description: Reports a crop loss event for a specific policy and land parcel. Transitions claim_status to 'reported'. Loss must be reported within 72 hours of the event. Valid loss_type values: 'drought', 'flood', 'pest_attack', 'cyclone', 'unseasonal_rainfall'. Requires session_token. This tool does NOT submit a formal claim — use pmfby_submit_claim. Fails if: policy is not 'active', reporting window expired, loss_type is unsupported, or a duplicate report exists for the same event.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

policy_id.description: Unique identifier of the insurance policy.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier of the insured land parcel.

loss_date.description: Date of the loss event in YYYY-MM-DD format.

loss_description.description: Brief description of the crop damage observed.
